## Specialized expertise

- Payment gateway integration — Noon Payments (Ilzam), Bookeey (Masahat Sukoon)
- Secure video delivery — segmented HLS streaming with protected playback
- Regulatory integration — ZATCA e-invoicing, WASL fleet synchronization
- Digital identity and e-signatures (Ilzam) — Nafath via Emdha, Yakeen identity verification, certificate-based digital signing
- Messaging (Ilzam) — Meta WhatsApp Business API
- Product and business direction — scoping and shaping requirements, not only implementation
- Delivery direction — planning features, distributing them across the team and verifying each one against its requirements before release
- Mobile — built the Ilzam mobile app in Flutter

## Selected projects

- iDara ERP — core ERP platform used by 300+ clients (customers, stores, invoices, employees): https://idara.net
- Fatoora — ZATCA e-invoice synchronization and compliance reporting, 60,000+ invoices submitted: https://fatoora.idara.sa
- Vehicle Tracking — real-time tracking with WASL sync and live dashboard: https://tracking.idara.net
- Umra.net — pilgrimage management ERP used by 300+ clients, logistics and hotel bookings: https://umra.net
- Ilzam — e-signature platform serving 100+ clients (Laravel web + Flutter app on iOS and Android) with Nafath, Yakeen, WhatsApp and Noon Payments: https://ilzam.sa
- Masahat Sukoon — Arabic e-learning platform, HLS video, Bookeey payments: https://masahatsukoon.com
- BASMAT AQAR — real estate marketplace: https://basmat-aqar.com
- Kassemha — expense-splitting app for friends, family and roommates (personal project): https://kassemha.com
